nodes.description: address public _owner; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged owner in withdraw and setReadyForSale.
bool public readyForSale; sale gate toggled by the owner and required in changeToColor and mintNFT.
uint256 public mintedCounter; number of black-and-white tokens minted, driving the distribution curve.
uint256 public colorCounter; number of color conversions, driving the color price curve.
uint8[] public availableNFTs; remaining purchasable token ids, popped and shuffled inside mintNFT.
mapping(uint8 => uint256) mintedPrice; records the price paid for each minted index.
EnumerableMap.UintToAddressMap private _tokenOwners; authoritative token id to owner map.
mapping(address => EnumerableSet.UintSet) private _holderTokens; per-holder enumerable token set.
mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals; per-token approvals cleared on burn and transfer.
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals; operator approvals.
uint256 public constant SALE_START_TIMESTAMP = 1611846000; declared but never referenced by the sale functions, so the time gate is not enforced.
external payable changeToColor(uint256[] calldata index); burns black-and-white tokens and mints the mirrored color tokens, then refunds excess ETH via a low-level call.
public payable mintNFT(); loops minting tokens using blockhash-derived indexing and refunds excess ETH with a low-level call.
public withdraw(); owner-only transfer of the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
public setReadyForSale(bool); owner-only toggle of the sale gate.
public view distributionCurve(bool _forColor); returns the current price based on colorCounter or mintedCounter.
internal _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId); mints then calls _checkOnERC721Received, executing a callback into the receiver.
internal _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId); writes _holderTokens and _tokenOwners.
internal _burn(uint256 tokenId); clears approvals and removes the token from holder and owner maps.
internal _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId); clears approvals and rewrites holder and owner mappings.
private _checkOnERC721Received(...); performs an external functionCall to onERC721Received on a contract receiver.
public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId); approval-gated transfer delegating to _transfer.
public safeTransferFrom(...); approval-gated transfer delegating to _safeTransfer/_transfer.
public view ownerOf(uint256 tokenId); resolves the owner from _tokenOwners and is used for authorization checks.
public view balanceOf(address owner); returns _holderTokens[owner].length().
Address.functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes data, uint256 value, string errorMessage); low-level value transfer call wrapper.
msg.sender inside changeToColor; used as the ownership proof for index tokens, the mint recipient and the refund recipient.
msg.sender inside mintNFT; the mint recipient and the recipient of the excess ETH refund.
msg.sender inside withdraw; compared against _owner and used as the balance transfer destination.
msg.sender inside setReadyForSale; the only access-control guard on the sale gate.
address(msg.sender).call{value: returnAmount}("") refund in changeToColor; forwards ETH to a caller-controlled address with no reentrancy guard.
address(msg.sender).call{value: returnAmount}("") refund in mintNFT; forwards ETH to a caller-controlled address inside the minting flow.
msg.sender.transfer(balance) in withdraw; sends the full contract balance to the owner with a 2300 gas stipend.
External callback to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received executed during _safeMint/_checkOnERC721Received while the calling state is still mid-update.
target.call{value: value}(data) low-level call inside Address.functionCallWithValue; unchecked arbitrary external call.
uint256[] calldata index; the black-and-white token ids the caller wants to convert to color.
local uint256 returnAmount tracking the remaining ETH to be refunded in changeToColor.
local uint256 requiredWei assigned from distributionCurve(true) on every loop iteration.
local uint256 colorIndex = index[_index].add(100); the mirrored color token id.
loop counter _index over the calldata index array in changeToColor.
local uint256 mintPrice recomputed from distributionCurve(false) inside the mintNFT while loop.
local uint256 returnAmount tracking the ETH left over for refund in mintNFT.
local uint256 randomMintIndex derived from blockhash(block.number - 1) modulo availableNFTs.length.
address to; receiver passed to _mint and used as the callback target in _checkOnERC721Received.
uint256 tokenId; token being minted to the receiver.
address from; current owner required to match ownerOf(tokenId) in _transfer.
address to; new owner written into _holderTokens and _tokenOwners.
uint256 tokenId; token being moved between holders.
bytes _data; caller-supplied payload forwarded to onERC721Received.
address to; receiver address checked with isContract and called via functionCall.

edges.reason: changeToColor reads readyForSale in its first require gate.
calldata index array drives the conversion loop.
ownerOf(index[_index]) is used to check token ownership before burning.
distributionCurve(true) supplies requiredWei for each color conversion.
changeToColor calls _burn on the black-and-white token.
changeToColor calls _safeMint for the mirrored color token, triggering the receiver callback.
colorCounter is incremented after the mint inside the loop.
the remaining returnAmount is forwarded to the refund low-level call.
returnAmount local is initialised from msg.value and updated each iteration.
requiredWei local is assigned from distributionCurve each iteration.
colorIndex is computed as index[_index] + 100 and passed to _safeMint.
the _index loop counter bounds iteration over the calldata array.
caller-controlled msg.sender determines ownership validation and refund destination in changeToColor.
msg.sender must equal ownerOf(index[_index]) for the conversion to proceed.
ETH is sent to the caller-controlled address via low-level call, enabling reentrancy before the function returns.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the receiver contract.
a malicious receiver can re-enter changeToColor during the callback, before colorCounter++ completes.
mintNFT reads readyForSale before accepting payment.
distributionCurve(false) provides the current mint price.
availableNFTs is indexed, swapped and popped during minting.
mintedPrice[uint8(randomMintIndex)] is written with the paid price.
mintedCounter is incremented for every successful mint.
mintNFT minted tokens through _safeMint, triggering the receiver callback.
left-over returnAmount is sent through the refund low-level call.
the mintPrice local is recomputed inside the while loop.
the returnAmount local is decremented by the mint price.
randomMintIndex is derived from blockhash(block.number - 1) modulo availableNFTs.length.
the refund is forwarded to the caller-controlled address after minting state changes.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and the refund recipient in mintNFT.
a malicious receiver can re-enter mintNFT during the onERC721Received callback.
withdraw authorises the caller by comparing msg.sender to _owner.
msg.sender gates the privileged withdraw function.
withdraw forwards the whole contract balance through the transfer call.
the full balance is transferred to the caller-controlled address.
the recipient fallback can attempt to re-enter payable entry points such as mintNFT.
setReadyForSale authorises the caller by comparing msg.sender to _owner.
msg.sender is the sole guard on the privileged sale-gate toggle.
setReadyForSale writes the readyForSale state variable.
distributionCurve reads mintedCounter for the black-and-white price tiers.
distributionCurve reads colorCounter when pricing color conversions.
_safeMint calls _mint before the receiver check.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs the external callback.
the to parameter becomes the mint recipient and callback target.
the tokenId parameter is minted and passed to the receiver check.
_mint writes the token owner into _tokenOwners.
_mint adds the token id to _holderTokens[to].
_burn removes the token from _tokenOwners.
_burn removes the token from _holderTokens[owner].
_burn clears the token approval by calling _approve(address(0), tokenId).
_transfer rewrites the owner entry in _tokenOwners.
_transfer moves the token id between _holderTokens sets.
_transfer clears the previous approval for the token.
the from parameter must match ownerOf(tokenId).
the to parameter becomes the new token owner.
the tokenId parameter selects the entry being rewritten.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received callback for contract receivers.
_checkOnERC721Received delegates the call to Address.functionCall.
the _data parameter is forwarded to onERC721Received.
the to parameter is the callback target address.
transferFrom delegates the state update to _transfer.
safeTransferFrom delegates the state update to _safeTransfer/_transfer.
ownerOf resolves the owner from _tokenOwners.
balanceOf reads the length of _holderTokens[owner].
functionCallWithValue performs the low-level target.call with value.

normalization_plan.reason: The calldata index array is only meaningful as the input to the changeToColor conversion loop and should be folded into that function node.
returnAmount is local scratch state of changeToColor used to size the refund and carries no independent identity.
requiredWei is a direct copy of the distributionCurve(true) return value and is best merged into the pricing function.
colorIndex is derived from the loop index and is only used to call _safeMint inside changeToColor.
The _index loop counter is an implementation detail of the changeToColor iteration.
mintPrice is recomputed from distributionCurve(false) on each iteration and should be merged into that function.
returnAmount is local accounting state of the mintNFT payment loop.
randomMintIndex is a blockhash-derived index used only to select the token within mintNFT.
The to parameter only has meaning as the receiver argument of _safeMint.
The tokenId parameter only has meaning as the minted token argument of _safeMint.
The from parameter is only used for the ownership require inside _transfer.
The to parameter is only used to rewrite ownership mappings inside _transfer.
The tokenId parameter selects the token rewritten by _transfer.
The _data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the onERC721Received external callback payload.
The to parameter is the untrusted receiver address targeted by the onERC721Received callback.
